title: finding(scripts/pm): `post-stamped.mjs` exits 4 "NOT STORED" when the platform's footer re-anchor COLLAPSES a blank line — a case its own refusal text says cannot happen ("takes nothing away either way")
body:
`scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` compares the bytes it sent against the bytes read back and exits **4 — NOT STORED** on any difference inside the sent region. Its refusal text states the model it is discriminating against:

> That is not the platform's footer re-anchoring, which either **appends its block or moves the newline around one already there, and takes nothing away either way** — something this act sent is not there.

⛔ **Measured counter-example: the re-anchor DID take something away, and the write landed anyway.**

## The reading

A `--body` write to objectstack-ai/objectui#9771 at 2026-09-18T14:13:23Z:

```
⚠️ read-back: sent 54579 byte(s), stored 54578 — the platform MUTATED the body.
   first difference at byte 54522:
     sent   …\n---\n_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
     stored …---\n_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
   ⛔ a byte this act sent is NOT the byte stored at that offset — the write did NOT land. Exit 4.
```

⇒ the entire difference is **one blank line immediately before the platform's own footer separator**, which the body already carried from a previous write.

## What the artefact actually says — read, as the refusal instructs

The refusal says 「READ THE ARTEFACT before writing anything that depends on it having landed」. Done, and it landed:

| | |
|:--|--:|
| stored body | 52194 bytes |
| this act's body with its tokens rendered | 52195 bytes |
| line count | 244 sent · 243 stored |
| **non-empty lines** | **178 sent · 178 stored** |
| ⭐ **non-empty line mismatches** | **0** |
| first differing line index | **241** of 244 — `""` vs `"---"`, i.e. the collapsed blank |

**Content probes on the stored body, subject and control in one pass:** the new ledger heading (`16 LANDED`) **1**, the new PR reference `objectui#9887` **4**, the new upstream card `objectstack#19046` **2**, the two new lane-fact markers **1** each, the widened count string **1**. ⇒ **every byte of new content is stored.**

## ⚠️ Why this matters more than a cosmetic false alarm

Exit 4's own text says 「⛔ **Do not retry blindly**: the one measured hit of this shape was a size refusal the platform never reported, so an identical second write reproduces it exactly.」

⇒ ⭐ **a caller that follows the refusal correctly concludes its round-boundary write did not happen**, and either re-sends (wasting a write and re-reading the same 4) or starts reconstructing a body that is already stored. ⚠️ This is the lane's own 「a number that is not a verdict」 shape, in the tool built to stop exactly that class: **the exit code names a failure the artefact does not have**.

⛔ And the false negative direction is the dangerous one to fix carelessly: exit 4 exists because a **real** silent truncation was measured once. ⇒ this card is ⛔ **not** 「relax the check」.

## The shape, ⛔ not ruled by the filer

- **A** — teach the comparator that a **collapsed blank line immediately preceding the platform footer** is the same re-anchoring class it already tolerates, and keep exit 4 for every other difference. Narrow, and keyed on position rather than on size.
- **B** — compare **normalised** content (non-empty lines) for the verdict, and report the byte difference as a warning. ⚠️ Weaker: it would also tolerate a real whitespace-only truncation.
- **C** — leave the code and correct the **refusal text**, which currently asserts a platform behaviour that this reading falsifies. Cheapest, and it at least stops the text from being wrong.

⭐ The first deliverable is the **criterion** — *which* mutations are the footer's and which are the sanitizer's — ⛔ not a patch. ⚠️ The refusal text's current claim (「takes nothing away either way」) is a **model of the platform**, and it is the thing measured false here.

## Dedupe words

- `post-stamped exit 4 footer newline`
- `read-back sent stored off by one newline`
- `NOT STORED false positive footer re-anchor`
- `footer re-anchoring takes nothing away`
